canonical_source.behavior: Run checks is always available to an authorized viewer, becomes busy/disabled while the real health check is running, and retries the same authoritative System Health read after failure.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The dedicated Run checks control invokes the existing React Query refetch for the active tenant System Health snapshot. It is disabled while a read is in flight, suppresses duplicate clicks, remains available after a failed read for recovery, and never displays a synthetic success result.

authorization.caller_override: query tenant/user/site values cannot replace the route-derived TenantContext

semantics.authoritative_reread: Every activation refetches the same tenant-scoped server endpoint; prior data is not presented as a new success when the reread fails.
semantics.duplicate_suppression: The control keeps a local pending guard in addition to React Query isFetching.
semantics.secrets: The server response remains allowlisted and focused tests verify a configuration secret sentinel is absent.
